name: Bai Lang
kicker: The landing hamlet on Hòn Lao
summary: Landing hamlet on Hòn Lao: walk the shore after the boat and stay for the village after dark. Breakfast stalls line the coast road. Hải Tạng, the founders’ hall, and the whale shrine are in this hamlet. The fee is 70,000 VND per person per visit from 10 June 2026, plus 20,000 VND sanitation on the city table. The boat fare is Check on arrival.
timeNeeded: The landing day, or a night
getThere: Boat from the Cửa Đại pier to Bai Lang.
heroCaption: The shore road at the Bai Lang landing, with the pier and the houses
body: Bai Lang is the landing on Hòn Lao, the only inhabited island. You step off the boat onto the shore road, with the pier, the houses, and the hill in one walk. Breakfast stalls line that coast road. The 16 September 2025 heritage study puts lunch around 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal around 17:00–18:00. A night here is a village house after the day boats have gone back to Cửa Đại.

Hải Tạng stands in Xóm Cấm, facing the fields called Đồng Chùa. The founders’ hall, Đình Tiền Hiền, and the whale shrine, Lăng Ông Ngư, are in the same hamlet. The 1998–1999 dig found Cham, Chinese, and West Asian ceramics, and the heritage centre reads the hamlet as a Cham-period stop for trading ships from the 8th to the 10th century. National relic, 2006. The heritage page describes that dig as a past excavation.
The fee is 70,000 VND per person per visit from 10 June 2026, plus 20,000 VND sanitation on the city table. Tickets are sold from 07:00 to 16:00. The boat fare is Check on arrival.

figures.caption: The same landing from the boat, with the yellow tower and the pier
figures.alt: The Bai Lang shore and a small pier, seen from the water, with a yellow tower and forested hill

gettingThere: Land at Bai Lang. The mainland boat leaves bến thủy nội địa Cửa Đại – Cù Lao Chàm. Passengers board from 08:00, with a crowd from 08:00 to 10:00, and life jackets are checked before a boat is cleared. Ticket sales run 07:00 to 16:00.
The city temple page puts Hải Tạng about 20 km from the Hoi An shore. The biodiversity agency says the commune is 18 km from Hoi An. Both distances are the crossing to this landing.

legs.heading: From Da Nang
legs.body: Da Nang International is VVDN on the civil-aviation AIP, southwest of the city and 3.2 km from the city centre. Go on to the Cửa Đại pier, then take the boat to Bai Lang.
